task: Review a 2,000-line pull request that rewrites the payment reconciliation algorithm. Find correctness bugs and unhandled edge cases. Read the diff and the existing tests; do not edit files.
context: The PR author is a Claude model, so the reviewer should come from a different model family. The user wants to watch the review in a visible terminal.
name: reviewer
prompt: Review the diff on this branch against main. Report only actionable correctness findings with file and line.
